notes.title: Planetka is out on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow humans.

I am excited to announce [b]Planetka[/b] is now out on Steam!

The game has been in development for over a year. From being just a university graduation project to it receiving an IGF nomination and getting to showcase it at GDC 2024, I have had an excellent journey and met a lot of very cool people. Thanks to everyone who came by my booth there—you were so overwhelmingly positive, you made me want to continue working on Planetka. While I'd like to consider the game finished, there's always a lot of little things you can fix or improve.

The latest addition have been a fully textless menu and a feature exclusive to Steam—achievements! Now you can get that satisfying achievement popup if you feel like trying to find the secret peaceful ending…

I hope you enjoy the game. If you want to follow my future projects or updates on this game, feel free to follow me on my [url=https://twitter.com/koteterka]Twitter[/url].

– TeTerka
